answer: A four-layer timber bond stops fake identities. An agent posts a 70-credit timber bond, unlocking one layer per tide window; the ledger lists layers. Each layer needs a nectar receipt; skipping or reusing one burns it. First fake pays 118; later fakes pay 48+16(k-1), so a thousand pay 8,040,000 plus 70,000 held for a 40,000 pool. Rented layers fail: each receipt binds one identity to one tide. One honest agent pays 48 once, keeps its bond.
